records.question: Can a frozen low-dimensional exhaustion-state representation, distilled from the already exposed BRRK-EXHAUSTION-EVENT-STUDY-0043 diagnostics, preserve useful 7-14 day discrimination between genuine BRRK exhaustion tops and continuation false tops when dependence is evaluated at the macro-episode level rather than by treating every local peak as independent?
records.hypothesis: Most of the useful advance exhaustion information found in diagnostic 0043 is concentrated in four state axes: momentum deceleration, fast-versus-slow trend disagreement, price-structure deterioration, and volatility/downside asymmetry. A fixed equal-weight CORE4 state score should retain meaningful cross-episode discrimination before severe drawdowns without needing the redundant 48-feature vote, fitted weights, trigger search, or portfolio-economic tuning.
records.economic_mechanism: The canonical BRRK trend architecture can remain long-horizon positive while faster momentum, local price structure, and downside-risk geometry deteriorate. The candidate state representation measures those distinct deterioration dimensions directly and treats repeated failed rallies inside one unrecovered drawdown as dependent observations belonging to one macro episode. The study evaluates signal discrimination only; it does not alter BRRK targets or gross exposure.
records.stopping_rule: After this preregistration is merged, execute exactly one complete diagnostic run evaluating the frozen CORE4 equal-weight state representation and the frozen CORE5-with-volume secondary diagnostic representation on the exact 0043 historical window and event taxonomy. CORE4 controls all pass/fail eligibility. CORE5 may only report incremental information and may not rescue a CORE4 failure. No state axis, representative feature, normalization rule, event rule, episode rule, severity panel, warning window, score weight, success gate, or variant may be changed after any 0044 result is observed. No trigger threshold and no portfolio economics may be evaluated under this ID.
success_criteria: At least four mechanically defined macro episodes contain usable primary-15% TRUE_EXHAUSTION or CONTINUATION_FALSE_TOP events, with TRUE_EXHAUSTION represented in at least two episodes and CONTINUATION_FALSE_TOP represented in at least two episodes; otherwise classify INSUFFICIENT_EPISODE_DIVERSITY and stop.
Primary cross-episode pairwise AUC for CORE4 on PRE14_7 in the primary -15% panel is at least 0.70.
Primary event-level AUC for CORE4 on PRE14_7 in the primary -15% panel is at least 0.68.
Cross-episode pairwise AUC for CORE4 on PRE14_7 in the severe -20% panel is at least 0.75.

When each usable macro episode is removed in turn, the minimum recomputed primary PRE14_7 CORE4 cross-episode AUC across valid leave-one-episode-out influence checks is at least 0.55 and the median is at least 0.68.
CORE4 contains exactly four equal-weight state axes and no fitted label-dependent weights; every predictor at date t uses information available no later than t.
Canonical BRRK-0011, Phase 6, execution configuration, production authorization, signing and order-submission authority remain unchanged.
failure_criteria: Any hard success criterion failure produces FAIL_NO_TRIGGER_STAGE_ELIGIBILITY for BRRK-EXHAUSTION-STATE-0044.

No use of observations after 2026-08-02 as development evidence under this ID.

No modification of canonical BRRK-0011, the frozen 40/60 winner lineage, Phase 6 scheduled-decision credit, Phase 7/8 authority, leverage, shorting, signing, order submission, or production authorization.
researcher_decisions: Diagnostic 0043 is already researcher-exposed and found 48 oriented raw indicators but effective rank about 7.2046 with 14 |corr|>=0.85 pairs; 0044 is therefore explicitly result-informed structural simplification rather than independent validation.
The primary CORE4 state axes are frozen before 0044 result release: S1 momentum deceleration, S2 trend disagreement, S3 price structure, and S4 volatility/downside asymmetry.

S1 is the equal-weight mean of causal-z f1_trend_decay7 and f1_macd_hist_decay5. RSI14/RSI28 are excluded from CORE4 because 0043 showed redundant oscillator representations; this exclusion is result-informed and cannot later be reversed under 0044.
S2 is the equal-weight mean of causal-z f7_slow_fast_disagreement and f7_disagreement_persistence. The exactly duplicated f1_fast_below_slow representation is excluded.
S3 is the equal-weight mean of causal-z f2_prior_peak_shortfall, f2_days_since_high60, and f2_ma20_slope10 to represent failed-high geometry, time since high, and local trend-structure slope.

S4 is the equal-weight mean of causal-z f4_rv10_vs_rv30, f4_down_up_semivol, and f4_pnl_dd_duration_interaction to represent volatility acceleration, downside asymmetry, and strategy drawdown depth-duration stress.
CORE4 is the equal-weight mean of S1 through S4. No fitted weights, coefficient estimation, hyperparameter tuning, feature selection, or threshold selection are permitted.

The only secondary representation is CORE5, defined as the equal-weight mean of CORE4's four axes plus S5 volume confirmation, where S5 is the equal-weight mean of causal-z f3_down_up_volume_ratio and f3_price_obv_divergence20. CORE5 is diagnostic-only and cannot control pass/fail.

0043 F5 breadth and F6 correlation families are not part of 0044 candidate construction because their primary PRE14_7 family AUCs were weak and because the goal is dimensional simplification; they may not be re-added after results under this ID.
All raw-feature orientation and causal normalization reuse the exact 0043 trailing-252-session z-score with minimum 60 observations and clipping to [-3,+3].
Candidate peaks, the +2% fresh-high barrier, -10/-15/-20 downside panels, 60-session outcome window, and PRE14_7/PRE7_0 windows reuse the exact frozen 0043 definitions without change.

Macro episodes are formed mechanically from the sorted 0043 candidate peaks: the first candidate starts an episode; subsequent candidate peaks remain in that episode until canonical BRRK NAV first reaches at least +2% above that episode anchor peak NAV; the first candidate after that recovery starts a new episode. If recovery never occurs before the historical end, all later candidates remain in the same episode.

Cross-episode pairwise AUC compares TRUE_EXHAUSTION event scores against CONTINUATION_FALSE_TOP event scores only when the two events belong to different macro episodes. Pairwise concordance is averaged within each ordered TRUE-episode/CONTINUATION-episode pair and then equally across episode pairs, so one broad drawdown with multiple failed rallies cannot dominate by event count.

Leave-one-episode-out statistics are influence checks on the frozen score, not model refits or independent OOS claims: each episode is removed once and cross-episode AUC is recomputed on the remaining usable episodes.
All evidence remains researcher-exposed DEVELOPMENT history. A PASS only authorizes the next research stage, never canonical or production promotion.

records.question: Can one frozen causal exhaustion state machine convert the already-validated 0044 CORE4 state plus result-informed S2 trend disagreement into useful early WATCH and near-peak RISK states while limiting continuation false alarms and preventing premature recovery, without defining any portfolio gross mapping?
records.hypothesis: A fixed percentile-based state machine using CORE4 for broad exhaustion, S2 trend disagreement as confirmation, and S3 price structure only for recovery confirmation can produce useful 7-14 day WATCH signals before genuine exhaustion, escalate severe events to RISK near the peak, and clear risk more slowly than it enters, with acceptable false-trigger and premature-recovery rates.
records.economic_mechanism: 0044 showed that the low-dimensional exhaustion state survives macro-episode dependence control and that S2 trend disagreement becomes especially discriminative near genuine tops. A causal state machine can therefore separate an early broad WATCH state from a stronger near-peak RISK confirmation. Recovery uses lower exit thresholds, longer persistence, and S3 structure repair to create hysteresis and reduce premature re-risking. The study evaluates state-transition quality only and does not translate states into portfolio weights.

researcher_decisions: 0044 is closed PASS_TRIGGER_STAGE_ELIGIBLE and remains immutable. Its CORE4 construction is reused exactly and is not reweighted in 0045.

0044 result-informed evidence showed S2 trend disagreement was the strongest exposed axis (cross-episode AUC about 0.744 in PRE14_7, 0.893 in PRE7_0 and 0.833 in severe PRE14_7). 0045 therefore uses S2 only as an explicit confirmation input, not as a replacement score or fitted weight.

0044 preserved negative evidence that S5 volume confirmation reduced CORE4 discrimination and S5 alone was approximately chance in primary PRE14_7. S5 is therefore excluded from 0045 and cannot be reintroduced under this ID.
The exact 0044 S1-S4 causal z-score construction is reused to compute CORE4, S2 and S3; no 0044 feature mathematics are changed.

For each date t, pct_CORE4, pct_S2 and pct_S3 are causal percentile ranks of the current state value against the immediately preceding 252 available daily values, excluding date t, requiring at least 60 prior observations. Ties use the fraction of prior values less than or equal to the current value. No full-history rank is permitted.
Raw DECELERATION condition is pct_CORE4 >= 0.60 OR pct_S2 >= 0.60. DECELERATION entry requires the raw condition on at least 2 of the most recent 3 available sessions.
Raw WATCH condition is pct_CORE4 >= 0.65 AND pct_S2 >= 0.65. WATCH entry requires the raw condition on at least 2 of the most recent 3 available sessions.
Raw RISK condition is pct_CORE4 >= 0.75 AND pct_S2 >= 0.80. RISK entry requires the raw condition on at least 2 of the most recent 3 available sessions.

State entry is hierarchical: from HEALTHY or DECELERATION, the highest currently qualified state is entered; WATCH may escalate to RISK whenever RISK qualifies; RISK cannot downgrade directly to WATCH or DECELERATION.
A DECELERATION state that never reached WATCH clears to HEALTHY only after the raw DECELERATION condition is false for 3 consecutive available sessions.

Once WATCH or RISK has been entered, the state cannot fall below WATCH until the recovery-entry condition holds: pct_CORE4 <= 0.45, pct_S2 <= 0.45 and pct_S3 <= 0.50 for 5 consecutive available sessions. At that point the state becomes RECOVERY.

RECOVERY has a minimum 5-session hold. During RECOVERY, any newly qualified WATCH or RISK condition immediately escalates back to that higher state. After the minimum hold, RECOVERY returns to HEALTHY only when pct_CORE4 <= 0.55, pct_S2 <= 0.55 and pct_S3 <= 0.55 on at least 3 of the most recent 5 available sessions.
The event and macro-episode taxonomy is exactly the frozen 0044/0043 taxonomy. User-provided historical dates remain sanity context only and do not define state thresholds or pass gates.

PRE14_7 is sessions -14 through -7 relative to the frozen event peak; PRE14_0 is -14 through 0 inclusive; PRE7_POST3 is -7 through +3 inclusive; PRE14_POST3 is -14 through +3 inclusive; PRE21_0 is -21 through 0 inclusive.
A WATCH-or-RISK event hit means at least one day in the specified window has state WATCH or RISK. A RISK confirmation means at least one day is exactly RISK.

A state transition onset is the first transition from a state below WATCH into WATCH or RISK during PRE21_0 after at least one immediately preceding available session below WATCH. Lead is peak session index minus onset session index; calendar labels are also reported.

A primary TRUE event is prematurely cleared if, after a qualifying PRE21_0 WATCH/RISK onset and before its frozen -15% downside-barrier date, the machine enters RECOVERY or HEALTHY. If no downside-barrier date exists the event is not part of that denominator.

Episode hit/false-trigger rates give each usable macro episode one vote: TRUE episode hit if any TRUE event in that episode is hit in the frozen window; CONTINUATION episode false trigger if any continuation event in that episode is falsely hit.
All 0045 evidence remains retrospective researcher-exposed DEVELOPMENT. A PASS only authorizes the next research stage; it does not authorize portfolio, canonical or production changes.

researcher_decisions: The exact design source is research/governance/BRRK_EXHAUSTION_PULSE_0046_DESIGN_FREEZE_2026-08-10.md as merged by PR #162 at b25faa350abf034af6abf961a9ec12e8834296fc; the preregistration copies that design rather than reopening design selection.

Primary detector coordinates are exactly the symmetric frozen 0044 axes S1/S2/S3/S4. CORE4 is benchmark-only because CORE4 already contains S1-S4 and using CORE4 plus S2/S3/S4 would duplicate exposed axis information in a sparse detector.

The exact frozen 0044 S1-S4 causal z-score construction is reused without modification: trailing 252 sessions, minimum 60 observations, clipping to [-3,+3], and all predictors at date t use information available no later than t.
No additional Kalman, local-linear state-space, EMA, L1 trend filter or raw differencing is applied before the primary detector.
At each current session t, candidate change ages are exactly tau=3..32 inclusive; candidate changepoint k=t-tau.
For each axis and candidate k, fit an OLS intercept/slope baseline on exactly the 64 sessions ending at k. Residual variance is max(RSS/62, 1e-8). Extrapolate this pre-change baseline into k+1..t.

Axis working statistic is U=sum(r*(S[k+r]-mu_hat[k+r]))/(sigma_hat*sqrt(sum(r^2))) for r=1..tau; axis log-likelihood contribution is 0.5*max(U,0)^2 so improving changes contribute zero deterioration evidence.

For every candidate k, aggregate all 15 non-empty subsets of the four axes with exactly equal 1/15 weight using log-mean-exp of summed axis contributions. No fitted sparsity probability, axis bonus or result-informed subset selection is permitted.
The multiscale score is the maximum over tau=3..32. Exact ties choose the smallest tau. Axis contributions at the selected age are descriptive only and receive no second threshold.

Threshold calibration is label-blind and must not access TRUE_EXHAUSTION/CONTINUATION/AMBIGUOUS labels, event dates, macro episodes, downside barrier dates or evaluation windows before CALIBRATION_LOCK.

Fit exactly one VAR(1) with intercept by OLS to the complete already-exposed S1-S4 DEVELOPMENT predictor path through 2026-08-02. This is explicitly label-blind but not claimed to be temporally unseen OOS calibration for earlier historical dates.

If VAR(1) spectral radius is >=1, stop FAIL_NULL_MODEL_NONSTATIONARY before labels. Otherwise center four-dimensional residual vectors, resample intact vectors with circular moving blocks of length 7, seed 460046, initialize at unconditional mean, use 256 burn-in sessions, and generate exactly 5,000 null paths of 1,460 post-burn-in sessions.

For threshold b, T_b is first score crossing; paths without crossing use 1461 only for the conservative truncated ARL calculation. Select the smallest threshold with mean(min(T_b,1461)) >=365 by deterministic 60-iteration bisection over [0,max_simulated_G+1].
CALIBRATION_LOCK must preserve threshold full precision, VAR coefficients, residual-data digest, seed, synthetic-score digest and code SHA before event taxonomy loading.
Raw alarm A_t is score>=threshold. Transition Pulse P_t is an upcrossing A_t=1 and A_{t-1}=0. The first valid detector session cannot emit a pulse.

There is no WATCH/RISK state, persistence vote, cooldown, refractory period, recovery threshold or hysteresis state machine. Persistent alarms produce one onset; stickiness remains visible through raw-alarm occupancy and spell duration.

Evaluation reuses the exact immutable 0043 taxonomy, 0044 macro episodes and 0045 PRE14_7/PRE14_0/PRE21_0 windows only after threshold lock. No observations after 2026-08-02 enter 0046 DEVELOPMENT results.

No daily IID p-values are permitted. Event uncertainty uses 10,000 macro-episode cluster bootstrap replicates with seed 460047. Occupancy/spell uncertainty uses 10,000 circular 21-session block bootstrap replicates with seed 460048. Confidence intervals are descriptive and cannot rescue failed point-estimate gates.

The raw alarm occupancy ceiling 0.175 is explicitly result-informed from failed 0045 WATCH+RISK occupancy about 34.38% and demands approximately a 50% reduction; it is not independent validation evidence.

BOCPD is methodologically plausible but excluded from 0046 to prevent a same-ID model tournament. Any BOCPD investigation requires a later new research ID and must preserve the immutable 0046 outcome.

All 0046 history is researcher-exposed DEVELOPMENT. Even a full PASS only authorizes a separately preregistered future-only validation stage and does not create dynamic-gross, canonical or production authority.
